name: Threat Modeling Tests
description: Verify threat modeling tool functionality and output quality

test_cases.name: Component threat model generation
test_cases.description: Generate STRIDE threats for a single component

input.system_description: REST API endpoint that processes user authentication requests using JWT tokens stored in a relational database

assertions.description: Should identify at least 3 STRIDE threats

test_cases.name: Layer threat model generation
test_cases.description: Generate STRIDE threats for an architecture layer

input.system_description: API Gateway layer handling all external traffic with rate limiting, WAF protection, and JWT validation

test_cases.name: Full system threat model
test_cases.description: Generate comprehensive STRIDE threat model for full system

input.system_description: Multi-tier web application: Angular frontend → Spring Boot backend → SQL Server database, with RabbitMQ messaging and HashiCorp Vault for secrets

test_cases.name: Threat output validation
test_cases.description: Verify threat output contains required fields

assertions.description: Each threat must have required fields
